Triage Gate.rationale: bug-analysis validated 30/30 on first attempt; severity high (technical impact only), deterministic. The analyst measured every consecutive phase pair of every workflow with the runtime's own loaders: 29 hand-offs, 13 blocked at G5-INPUT across five workflows (investigate 3 of 4, research 3 of 4, review-pull-request 2 of 4, release 2 of 4, implement-feature 2 of 5), 10 distinct identifier/consumer pairs; reproduced the symptom on a throwaway mirror; corrected the defect report (research has three gaps not four, scope wider than investigate and research, workaround overstated, supplied inputs persist in the pool). Operator scoping decision: this run repairs the investigate and research chains and their two profile rows; the other three workflows are recorded as follow-ups. omn-dev-1-bug-analyst produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Fix Gate.decided_by: omn-dev-2-reviewer subagent, recorded by session operator
Fix Gate.rationale: Reviewer verdict approve-with-corrections, no critical or high findings, every finding backed by a command it ran. Rationale recorded verbatim: The fix removes the cause for both chains without touching the guard. Independently re-derived with the runtime's own functions and the real next command on a scratch copy, every phase of investigate and research passes G5-INPUT from problem-statement alone; blocked hand-offs fall from 13 to exactly the 7 out-of-scope gaps; and undeclared, optional-only, empty and withdrawn-route inputs are still rejected. The context-agent and documentation contract texts, registry records and host registrations agree with their manifests at 1.1.0, following the FC-011 precedent. The added Input-column edges change each workflow's graph by exactly one hard edge to an already-completed earlier phase, so existing runs stay valid and all slice, multi-phase, manifest, registry, validator and self-hosting verifiers return the same results as before. The new regression module fails all 20 tests on a reconstructed pre-fix tree and passes all 20 after. Two non-blocking defects stayed open: documentation's findings phases receive both the option-analysis draft and the final recommendation under one type with no contract rule for which governs (F-001, medium), and its source-input type list was incomplete (F-002, low). Subsequently closed by a correction pass by omn-dev-1-implement per the operator's decision (the recommendation-phase artifact governs, the option-analysis one is a superseded draft and context only; technical-recommendation added to the sourceInputs vocabulary and the release-note template comment) with two new tests that fail before and pass after. Operator re-verified: 47 tests in the three relevant modules, verify_manifests 2/2, registry coverage 8/8, verify_validators 6/6. Full suite 690 tests discovered, 687 pass; the 3 failures are all in test_demo_capture.EndToEndEditTestCase (ffmpeg rejects the filter_complex_script option) and reproduce identically on a clean export of the base commit: WinGet installed ffmpeg 9.0.2 at 19:32 today, after this session's earlier green runs, so this is an environment regression independent of this change, recorded as a follow-up. omn-dev-1-implement produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Verification Gate.rationale: validation-report validated 31/31; verdict pass, 8 of 8 criteria met on commands QA executed on throwaway copies: both chains pass G5-INPUT at all 5 phases from problem-statement alone (pre-fix copy blocks at technical-discovery / technical-validation), census 13 blocked hand-offs before and 7 after, exactly the known-gap set; 10 acceptance and rejection cases with 0 unexpected; 22 of 22 handoff tests pass and all fail on the pre-fix copy; verify_manifests 2/2, registry coverage 8/8, verify_validators 6/6, vertical slice 10/10 and multi-phase 15/15 on the copy; SHA-256 of all 1114 files under runs unchanged; versions agree at 1.1.0 and 17 of 17 mirror pairs identical; no runtime function, validator or gate changed. The 3 test_demo_capture EndToEndEditTestCase failures were independently reproduced on a clean export of the base commit (ffmpeg 9.0.2 rejects filter_complex_script) and recorded as defect DF-001, outside this repair. omn-qa produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Closure Gate.rationale: Five phases executed, five artifacts validated by their registered validators (30/30, 30/30, 32/32, 31/31, 34/34), zero charged retries; closure first run failed one offline blocking check (C6.2) and was corrected by the producer before completion. Three prior gates decided by non-producing owners with an independently dispatched reviewer whose findings were command-backed; the review's medium finding (two technical-recommendation artifacts without a precedence rule) was closed before the gate rather than carried. The investigate and research hand-offs are repaired: 13 blocked hand-offs fall to the 7 out-of-scope gaps, pinned in tests as known gaps. Disclosed: 3 test_demo_capture failures from an ffmpeg 9.0.2 incompatibility reproduced on the clean base commit (DF-001, separate defect); the implementer host registration version mismatch (separate defect); the 7 remaining blocked hand-offs (follow-ups). omn-orchestrator produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.
